frame_validation: PASS:80 frames,16 unique per clip,384 square,binary alpha,zero transparent RGB,no edge contact

export_spill.method: 8-connected components at alpha > 127 (solid) and > 16 (visible edge) on the raw sheet; a component belongs to the cell holding most of its pixels; cells are forge_core.rounded_grid_boxes; specks are forge_core.alpha_hygiene('both') counts
notProven: Whether an overhang is intended art such as a tail or weapon trail.
Whether a cell's pose, anatomy or identity is correct; run sheet_qc.py frames and look at the frames.
That a different crop or slicing method would be safe: only the nominal grid was measured.

checks.note: solid parts crossing a cell line are cut or misassigned when the sheet is sliced
the same test on the visible edge (alpha > 16)
art touching the sheet border was cut by the image edge
the first 16 cells must each hold a subject
solid pixels within 8 px of a cell line; a different crop or rounding can cut them
owned art closer than 1% of the cell to its edge; ask for more margin next time
alpha haze and detached specks; process removes them with --alpha-hygiene both

motion.method: solid alpha > 127; head ratio by multi-scale template match of the head band against the median frame; best-shift silhouette IoU; phases from ground clearance and stride width; NEAR/FAR lead from the lightness of the two feet (FAR one shade darker); torso x from the trunk columns of the torso band; seams from forge_core.transition_mae (premultiplied RGBA)
notProven: Pose quality, anatomy, appeal and readability at game scale: look at frames-review.png and the game-size frames.
That the head band holds only the head: arms raised into it change the match.
NEAR/FAR leads in auto mode rely on the 'FAR limbs one shade darker' convention; declare the colours to be sure.
Phase labels come from feet clearance and stride width, not from the pose.

checks.note: head scale against the median frame (frame 0 template)
head match residual over the median: face or costume drift
pairs with best-shift silhouette IoU at or above the threshold and similar colours
needs --cycle run or walk and an even frame count of at least 4
needs --cycle run or walk and an even frame count of at least 4
range of the torso x in game px; scale_frames --root-lock torso-x removes it
ground line of each sheet row; scale_frames --row-baseline aligns them
largest frame-to-frame change over the median step; review these joins first
